description: This file contains JavaScript code for building and managing a nested accordion menu widget in a Drupal project, including functions for menu interaction, active state management, and theming.

methods.name: drupalToolbarMenuHorizontal
methods.description: Maintains active tab in horizontal menu orientation based on current URL path.

methods.name: drupalToolbarMenu
methods.description: Initializes and manages the nested toolbar menu, handling toggle actions, active states, and menu structure.

methods.name: toolbarMenuItemToggle
methods.description: Provides HTML for a toggle button used within the menu.
